title: Hard Lessons in Combat Medicine from Ukraine
gist: An Insider episode note: physician John Quinn, drawing on years of work in Ukraine and a June 18 article, argues NATO must absorb Ukraine's combat-medicine lessons — including Russian targeting of health workers and infrastructure and the role of medical augmentation — and describes the war's damage to Ukraine's wider healthcare system.

insights.claim: Ukraine's battlefield medical experience contains crucial lessons that NATO and other militaries should be learning from, according to a physician with years of in-country experience.
insights.speaker: War on the Rocks
insights.so_what: Allied medical readiness is an underfunded line item relative to platforms; expect procurement attention to casualty evacuation, field-care and medical logistics.
insights.quote: he drew on that background to identify crucial lessons that NATO and others should learn from combat medicine in Ukraine
insights.locator: John Quinn has years of experience

insights.claim: Medical augmentation — reinforcing military medical capacity with additional personnel and resources — is identified as an important element of sustaining forces in a high-intensity war.
insights.speaker: War on the Rocks
insights.so_what: A concrete capability gap that translates into demand for medical personnel pipelines and field-hospital capacity in European defense budgets.

insights.claim: Russian forces have targeted health workers and healthcare infrastructure in Ukraine, making medical personnel part of the contested battlespace rather than protected rear-area assets.
insights.speaker: War on the Rocks
insights.so_what: Assume in future peer conflicts that medical assets are targets, not sanctuaries — a planning assumption that changes force design and cost.
insights.quote: Russian targeting of health workers and infrastructure
insights.locator: the major challenges for combat medicine in the war

insights.claim: The war has had a broad impact on Ukraine's national healthcare system beyond the immediate battlefield casualty burden.
insights.speaker: War on the Rocks
insights.so_what: Reconstruction of Ukrainian healthcare is a durable multi-year spending theme separate from military aid flows.
insights.quote: the war's broader impact on the country's healthcare system
